
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Can-daydayup/p/19175318" title="发布于 2025-10-29 20:25">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">一个开源免费、轻量级的 Avalonia UI 控件库</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>前言</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>今天大姚给大家分享一个开源免费（MIT license）、轻量级的 Avalonia UI 控件库：Aura.UI。可供大家学习、参考与借鉴使用。</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202510/1336199-20251029202248372-1883202022.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Avalonia介绍</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Avalonia是一个强大的框架，使开发人员能够使用.NET创建跨平台应用程序。它使用自己的渲染引擎绘制UI控件，确保在Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS和WebAssembly等不同平台上具有一致的外观和行为。这意味着开发人员可以共享他们的UI代码，并在不同的目标平台上保持统一的外观和感觉。</span></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>可用控件</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>FloatingButtonBar（浮动按钮栏）</span></li>
<li><span>ModernSlider（现代滑块）</span></li>
<li><span>ProgressRing（进度环）</span></li>
<li><span>GroupBox（分组框）</span></li>
<li><span>CardCollection（卡片集合）</span></li>
<li><span>AuraTabView（Aura标签视图）</span></li>
<li><span>NavigationView（导航视图）</span></li>
<li><span>Ribbon（功能区）</span></li>
<li><span>ContentDialog（内容对话框）</span></li>
<li><span>MessageDialog（消息对话框）</span></li>
<li><span>BlurryImage（模糊图像）</span></li>
<li><span>Badge（徽章）</span></li>
<li><span>RadialSlider（径向滑块）</span></li>
</ul>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>项目源代码</span></h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202510/1336199-20251029202302174-1540490298.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>控件使用</span></h2>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>安装 NuGet 包</span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong>UI核心包：</strong></p>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span data-cacheurl="" data-remoteid="" data-lazy-bgimg="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_svg/9M0PhLTmTIeLmnQLStMsiaFicw8H6Icic57UnsCeUyFRoZMjeibibPnoHhkOseMt7lJVOyA9DYZU3Z8MdjOCw93aaQGyvmX505CnF/640?wx_fmt=svg&amp;from=appmsg" data-fail="0"><code><span>dotnet add package Aura.UI --version 0.1.4.2<br></span></code></span></pre>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong>样式包:</strong></p>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span data-cacheurl="" data-remoteid="" data-lazy-bgimg="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_svg/9M0PhLTmTIeLmnQLStMsiaFicw8H6Icic57UnsCeUyFRoZMjeibibPnoHhkOseMt7lJVOyA9DYZU3Z8MdjOCw93aaQGyvmX505CnF/640?wx_fmt=svg&amp;from=appmsg" data-fail="0"><code><span>dotnet add package Aura.UI.FluentTheme --version 0.1.4.2<br></span></code></span></pre>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Fluent 主题样式设置</span></h3>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span data-cacheurl="" data-remoteid="" data-lazy-bgimg="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_svg/9M0PhLTmTIeLmnQLStMsiaFicw8H6Icic57UnsCeUyFRoZMjeibibPnoHhkOseMt7lJVOyA9DYZU3Z8MdjOCw93aaQGyvmX505CnF/640?wx_fmt=svg&amp;from=appmsg" data-fail="0"><code><span>&lt;Application xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;x:Class="YourApp.App"<span>&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&lt;Application.Styles&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;FluentTheme Mode="Light"<span>/&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;StyleInclude Source="avares://Aura.UI.FluentTheme/AuraUI.xaml"<span>/&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&lt;/Application.Styles&gt;&nbsp;<br><span>&lt;/Application&gt;<br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></span></pre>
